evidence.quote: Valentin went down on his hands and knees and examined with his closest professional attention the grass and ground for some twenty yards round the body
evidence.paraphrase: The detective methodically examines the physical scene around the body for evidence.

evidence.quote: There are five colossal difficulties," said the doctor quietly; "like high walls within walls.
evidence.paraphrase: The doctor systematically enumerates five logical difficulties in the case for investigation.

evidence.quote: I should say that it could not be done with a knife at all," said the pale doctor.
evidence.paraphrase: The doctor gives a technical assessment of what tool could produce the clean decapitation.

evidence.quote: on examination I found many cuts across the truncated section; in other words, they were struck after the head was off.
evidence.paraphrase: The doctor explains, from examination, that the cuts were made after decapitation.
